goal: FG-333: FlowGuard's own tree is clean and fully explained (model job_matching_example with the example's five invariants)

components.summary: Runs model proofs, bound tests and the system root model.
responsibilities: run every model, system included, with known-bad and conformance checks
fail a model whose rule no known-bad variant breaks
read code facts for conformance and fail missing or unconsulted anchors
clean up model and pytest shard subprocesses in bounded time
run bound tests per item and require each to reach an anchor
print at most three open hazard hints per model
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested

components.summary: Renders the static model tree with its facets, owner search and architecture review.
responsibilities: show the tree, Mermaid and digests with static facets and coverage
find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths
compare current and target facets and list the rules a target changes
show the model rules and flows each component relies on
replay the job-matching model on its production code

remove: responsibility:give conformance a static code-facts reader
responsibility:report missing, placeholder or unconsulted anchors as model failures
